description: A controlled NextItNet cold start for sequential recommendation on four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent NextItNet-family model per category and select changes using macro-average validation HR@10.
motivation: Establish a reproducible family-specific baseline so improvements reflect model and training changes under fixed data splits, seeds, evaluation rules, and compute limits.
implementation_notes: Use the host-supplied corrected baseline; its source and detailed architecture were not included. Preserve the NextItNet backbone, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, and 200 batches per epoch. Read DATA_DIR from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and save artifacts beneath the trial directory. For left-padded histories, read out the final nonpadding position rather than count-1. Keep the checkpoint, predictor writer, generated working/predict.py, category routing, and ModelView interfaces consistent. Each category must load exactly one independently trained checkpoint; no ensembles or separately fitted score additions. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), using measured metrics and available public data only. The host evaluates 200 validation users per category with 99 unique negatives and evaluation seed 42. No measured results are supplied.
pseudocode:
Set preprocessing seed to 0 and training seed to 42.
Read DATA_DIR from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'].
For each of the four categories:
    Load the supplied fixed training and validation splits.
    Initialize the corrected NextItNet-family model.
    Train for at most 200 epochs with 200 batches per epoch.
    Save one selected model checkpoint beneath the trial directory.
    Run compatible diagnostic probes using available training data.
Generate working/predict.py with matching architecture and category routing.
For prediction:
    Load the category's single checkpoint.
    Encode the left-padded history and select its final nonpadding representation.
    Score candidate items through the trained network.
Have the host evaluate validation HR@10 and compute the four-category macro average.

originality.positive: Provides a carefully constrained, reproducible NextItNet experimental starting point.
originality.negative: The description specifies an evaluation protocol and corrected baseline, without introducing a new modeling mechanism.

future_potential.positive: Supports controlled exploration of jointly trained internal features, losses, sampling, and optimization within the NextItNet family.
future_potential.negative: Predictive improvements remain unverified; all experiments share a 43,200 GPU-second budget.

code_difficulty.positive: The supplied baseline and fixed compatibility interfaces provide a clear implementation starting point.
code_difficulty.negative: Maintaining padding correctness, diagnostic compatibility, checkpoint reconstruction, and four-category routing requires careful coordination.
